settings.headline: See your business more clearly.
settings.intro: Tell us about your data sources, attribution challenges, and reporting goals. We'll discuss how TraceKit could fit your workflows.

settings.heading: What to expect
settings.body: A focused conversation about your acquisition channels, commerce systems, reconciliation needs, and priorities.

settings.heading: What to prepare
settings.body: Bring a list of platforms you use and a few questions your current reporting cannot answer.

settings.heading: After the conversation
settings.body: We'll outline relevant product capabilities, dependencies, and sensible next steps.
